 2  PRAYER: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   praying to issue a writ of Mandamus, forbearing the respondents fr  detaining the consignments of betel nuts imported by the petitione  subjecting them to tests under the Prevention of Food Adulteration  1954 and for quality purposes under the Prevention of Food Adulter  Rules, 1955 and further direct the respondents to release the cons  of betel nuts imported by the petitioner forthwith without further
For Petitioner : Mr.B.Sathish Sundar

For Respondents : Mr.A.P.Srinivas, SSC  for R1 & R2  Mr.J.Madana Gopal Rao  for R3  No Appearance  for R4 to R6  ORDER It is settled proposition of law that a writ of mandamus will lie unless and until a request has been made to the authorities ventilating the grievances of the petitioner, when such request has either been rejected or kept pending for a considerable time.
2. In the instant case, the petitioner is of the view that the respondents are not entitled to detain the consignments of betel nuts imported by the petitioner for subjecting them to tests under the http://www.judis.nic.in Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and for quality purposes under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955.

If at all the petitioner is of the view that the respondents are not empowered to detain such consignments, it is always open to them to approach the respondents with an appropriate representation ventilating their grievances and this Court may not be justified in straightway issuing the writ of mandamus for the prayer sought for.
3.

Nevertheless, if the petitioner is still of the view that their grievance subsists, liberty is granted to them to approach the appropriate authorities ventilating their grievances by way of a representation and on receipt of such representation, the concerned respondent shall dispose of the same, on its own merits and in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
